FinFilings AI - Phase 1 benchmark output (raw)
================================================
Captured 2026-10-30 from the final tree. go1.27.1 linux/amd64, GOAMD64=v1,
AMD Ryzen 7 5800H (16 logical CPUs, GOMAXPROCS=16). Index files in the
default os.TempDir(). Machine was not isolated (desktop, normal background
load); expect a few percent run-to-run noise.

CAVEATS
- SearchFixtures*, IngestFixtures, and PostingIter use SYNTHETIC TEST
  FIXTURES / synthetic posting lists. They are not SEC/EDGAR corpus numbers
  and are not production latency.
- BitPackMatched: "dispatch" = packBits/unpackBits (SSE2 for widths 8 and 16
  on this build; scalar for 12), "scalar" = packBitsScalar/unpackBitsScalar,
  on the IDENTICAL 128-value input. Width 12 is a control with no SIMD kernel.
- PFOREncode/PFORDecode inputs choose widths 0, 6, 4 (reported in the
  "width" metric and asserted non-SIMD), so they measure the scalar path.
  PFORDecodeWidth/w8 and /w16 go through the SSE2 kernels; /w12 is scalar.
- MB/s is computed from b.SetBytes over uncompressed uint32 values (512 B per
  128-value block), not from compressed bytes.
